svg.title: Figure 12. Degree, position and partners
svg.desc: Figure 12. Left: a line chart of the median distance from the centre of the compartment against ten degree deciles, for all cell types and for the brain and the nerve cord separately. The lines are close to flat; the rank correlation between degree and distance is −0.043 over all 23,073 types, 0.018 in the brain and −0.144 in the nerve cord. Right: for each scope, the mean distance from a cell type to the centroid of its own partners against degree-matched random partners: all 127 against 321 µm, brain 121 against 259 µm, nerve cord 143 against 461 µm, a ratio of 0.397 overall.
